quad_remesher_workflow.boundary: target calculation, public scene.qremesher settings, and read-only native-result provenance only; it never invokes Remesh It or mutates Painter collections/materials

uvgami_unwrap.discovery: derive the enabled provider package from Blender's UVGAMI_OT_start operator module and import its sibling api module
uvgami_unwrap.boundary: UVgami owns its profile, live manager, native operator call, asynchronous job and UV validation; consumers store only its versioned receipts

painter_transfer.boundary: Painter High/Low collection classification, Painter-safe material isolation and Painter transfer checkpoints only; topology analysis and UV unwrapping remain provider-owned

painter_low_export_sync.input_contract: one exact <base>_low object is a member of Baking/low and asset_base is canonical
painter_low_export_sync.output_contract: a standalone static Low keeps its _low name under an exact <base> Empty, Send2UE Combine Child meshes is selected and Use immediate parent name is disabled when available, and the Low hierarchy is linked into Export; existing parented, shape-keyed, or rigged hierarchies are preserved

blender_collections.note: low/high/alpha are child collections of the 'Baking' root. The actual collection names are 'low'/'high'/'alpha', not 'Baking/low'. Role classification is by COLLECTION MEMBERSHIP, not by object-name suffix.

on_disk_layout.base: the folder that contains the .blend file
on_disk_layout.asset: the .blend filename stem (cleaned) - NOT a per-object name

naming.back_texture_set_behavior: Texture Sets ending in _back are backsides. They follow Low Poly as High change behavior, so low changes rebake instead of reload-only. The matching front Texture Set is the same name without _back; for example sibuki_01_back uses sibuki_01 as the Normal mesh-map source.

painter_cloth_export_required_channels.behavior: When Unreal_V2_Cloth is requested, the Painter plugin verifies real Texture Set stack channels before export and enables missing channels instead of exporting from user-channel fallbacks.

naming.texture_set_from_material: strip exactly one leading 'M_' from the Blender low material name (name[2:] when it startswith 'M_')

role_pairing_suffix.behavior: low<->high (baking) and low<->alpha (alpha detail) objects are paired by stripping a trailing role token and comparing the remaining base. The separator is optional and may be '_', '.', '-', a space, or nothing; an optional trailing number is allowed, so rock_high, rock_high_01 and rock_high1 all reduce to base 'rock'. A Blender '.001' duplicate suffix is stripped first. Matching is case-insensitive.
role_pairing_suffix.example: rock_low pairs with rock_high and rock_alpha
role_pairing_suffix.note: This suffix exists for PAIRING across roles, not for deciding which collection an object belongs to (that is collection membership).

solidify_plus_rim_handling.ui_toggle: Scene.substance_tools_baking.painter_low_hide_solidify_rim / Hide Solidify Rim in Painter Low, default True
solidify_plus_rim_handling.painter_low_fbx_rule: When the toggle is enabled, evaluate Solidify Plus so the generated inner/back shell remains, but temporarily export the copy with Fill Rim set to False so rim side faces are not sent to Painter. When disabled, export the current Blender state.
solidify_plus_rim_handling.final_export_rule: Keep the current Blender/user-facing state for final Send to Unreal export, normally including Fill Rim=True.
solidify_plus_rim_handling.do_not: Do not disable Solidify/modifiers as the Painter rimless path. That removes the generated inner/back shell and changes the intended baking target.
solidify_plus_rim_handling.reason: Filled rim faces can affect ray projection and mesh-map/smart-material masks in Painter. The final asset still needs the rim, so the export mode must split rim inclusion automatically instead of requiring separate manually maintained Low meshes.

json_ipc.atomic_write: each file is written to a '.<name>.tmp' sibling then os.replace()d into place

pending_request.location: %LOCALAPPDATA%/SubstanceTools/ (falls back to %TEMP%, then the user home)

painter_request.note: written to BOTH the texture dir and the low dir

status_values_in_use.SUCCESS: operation completed; Blender treats any value other than 'SUCCESS' as failure
status_values_in_use.ERROR: operation ran but did not succeed
status_values_in_use.FAILED: request could not be processed; marks the request so it is NOT retried forever

json_ipc.status_and_message_live_in: the export RESULT file (.substance_tools_export_result.json), written by the Painter plugin and read by Blender (result.get('status'), result.get('message'))

staleness_marker.behavior: Painter compares request_id (falling back to pipeline_hash) against the last one it processed (_last_polled_pipeline_hash) and skips a request it already handled. request_id is str(time.time_ns()).
staleness_marker.note: Stale-vs-current detection is ALREADY implemented via these markers - it is not a gap.

proposed_not_yet_implemented.note: Genuine gaps only. NOT written by the code today - do not assume present.

legacy_consumers: UE_Blender_Pipeline/ue_material_setup.py (inactive compatibility copy; does not implement the versioned SpeedTree handoff contract)
unreal_handoff_sidecar.purpose: Bridge UE Unique validation/material data to Send to Unreal and Unreal material post-import setup. Users are not expected to edit these files manually.

matching.individual_mesh: When Send to Unreal imports meshes individually, the sidecar name matches the mesh object/imported asset name.
matching.empty_combined_mesh: When Send to Unreal combines child meshes under an Empty, the sole sidecar for that asset unit matches the Empty/imported asset name.
matching.emission_rule: Write one sidecar per resolved export asset unit. An Empty-grouped unit does not publish a competing child-mesh sidecar.

top_level_fields.material_master: default material master preset for the sidecar. Tree-only sidecars use 'tree'; mixed or ordinary sidecars keep the safe 'prop' default while each material entry may override it.
top_level_fields.mesh_name: mesh or Empty asset name this sidecar is intended to match
top_level_fields.asset_prefix: cleaned blend-file/prefix value used by the handoff
top_level_fields.materials: array of material slot pipeline entries
top_level_fields.cleanup: object with precomputed source asset names that Send2UE/Unreal may delete from the imported mesh folder after material setup
top_level_fields.validation: optional per-mesh validation row for individual mesh sidecars
top_level_fields.validation_children: optional array of validation rows for Empty/group sidecars
top_level_fields.transfer_sources: optional array of transfer postprocess requests for Empty/group sidecars

material_entry_fields.name: Blender material name, expected to start with M_ when processed by Unreal
material_entry_fields.slot_index: best-effort material slot index; Unreal also matches by material name where possible
material_entry_fields.translucent: boolean; translucent entries may use the shared glass material path in Unreal
material_entry_fields.textures: legacy flat texture array; may be empty
material_entry_fields.layers: surface-layer texture array; may be empty
material_entry_fields.master_preset: optional preset key such as prop, cloth, layer, asset_surface, coat, or tree
material_entry_fields.tree_part: optional explicit UV/material-layer role: bark, branch, or leaf. Consumers must prefer this field over material-name heuristics.
material_entry_fields.tree_shading: optional explicit shading/master role: wood, foliage, or stem. This axis is independent from tree_part; for example a standalone stem uses tree_part=branch and tree_shading=stem.
material_entry_fields.material_layer: optional object used when the preset must create/update a MYI Material Layer Instance and assign it as the MI background layer instead of writing texture overrides onto the MI
material_entry_fields.instance_profile: optional SpeedTree model-wide management key copied from Tree Generator > SpeedTree SDK > User data. It is never inferred from material names.
material_entry_fields.material_instance_mode: when instance_profile is present this is 'create_or_reuse': create the resolved child MI only when absent, otherwise preserve and reuse the existing user-managed instance

material_layer_fields.assignment: currently 'background'; Send2UE assigns this MYI as the single Background layer on the target MI
material_layer_fields.parent: parent Material Layer asset path, for example /Game/Material/AssetSurface/Master/MaterialLayer/MY_Cloth
material_layer_fields.instance_path: target MYI asset path to create/update, for example /Game/Material/AssetSurface/MYI/Cloth/MYI_Cloth_Sibuki_01
material_layer_fields.texture_remap: map from sidecar layer texture params to MYI parameter names; params not listed here are intentionally left out of the MYI

texture_entry_fields.param: Surface-domain texture parameter name such as Albedo, Extra, Normal, Transmission, Subsurface, Emissive, Sheen Color, Sheen Opacity, or Sheen Roughness
texture_entry_fields.asset_name: Texture asset name to import/create in Unreal
texture_entry_fields.file: absolute texture file path written with forward slashes
texture_entry_fields.source_param: optional original Blender role when param was remapped

cloth_master_param_remap.reason: Cloth source-domain texture data is stored in a MYI background layer. BaseColor/ORM/Normal and the Sheen/Fuzz texture set are owned by MY_Cloth/MYI. The cloth master keeps the Substrate cloth slab and wires layer attributes into DiffuseAlbedo, Roughness, Anisotropy, Normal, FuzzColor, FuzzAmount, and FuzzRoughness.

classification.tree_part_axis: tree_part selects the UV/material-layer contract only: bark, branch, or leaf.
classification.tree_shading_axis: tree_shading independently selects the master/shading contract: wood, foliage, or stem.
classification.priority: Explicit tree_part/tree_shading wins. In name fallback, a leaf-atlas or leaf-family scope wins over a stem/twig subgroup label, so M_leaf_*_stem and M_leaf_*_twig remain tree_part=leaf and tree_shading=foliage. Standalone M_stem_common_* materials use tree_part=branch and tree_shading=stem. Other branch/twig materials use branch/wood; bark/trunk/stump materials use bark/wood.
classification.custom_properties: Blender material custom properties unreal_tree_part and unreal_tree_shading may explicitly set their respective axes.

tree_material_layer_contract.opacity_policy: Tree cutout opacity is handed off as one canonical non-virtual-texture parameter named Opacity Map. Alpha and Opacity source aliases normalize to Opacity Map; Transmission remains excluded because it is not the cutout contract.
tree_material_layer_contract.subsurface_policy: Subsurface is controlled by tree_shading, not tree_part. Only wood excludes Subsurface. Foliage and stem may resolve an explicit or sibling *_subsurface map (including a Megascans-style *_Translucency source) and assign it to the MYI. Foliage uses MSS_TWO_SIDED_WRAP; stem uses MSS_WRAP.
tree_material_layer_contract.master_selection: The entry-level preset remains 'tree'. Consumers select the master by tree_shading: wood=M_TreeAsset_Master, foliage=M_TreeAsset_Foliage_Master (TwoSidedWrap), and stem=M_TreeAsset_Stem_Master (Wrap). A stem therefore combines the Branch material layer with the stem master and Subsurface.
tree_material_layer_contract.legacy_normalization: Before an active export, legacy M_stem_05 references are normalized to M_stem_common_01. The legacy material, textures, backups, and historical data remain preserved and are not renamed or deleted.

speedtree_instance_profiles.source_field: SpeedTree 10.1 Tree Generator > SpeedTree SDK > User data
speedtree_instance_profiles.target_rule: <tree mi_folder>/MI_<base material name>_<literal profile>; for example M_stem_common_01 plus dead resolves to MI_stem_common_01_dead
speedtree_instance_profiles.ownership: The pipeline may update the base MI and MYI. If the resolved child MI is absent, create it once as a child of the base MI. If it already exists, reuse it without checkout, save, reparenting, duplication, or parameter changes so user Tint overrides remain intact.
speedtree_instance_profiles.literal_rule: The validated Tree User Data key is appended literally and case-insensitively. It is never inferred from material names. Atlas Leaf Mesh Builder Green/Yellow group names are production metadata only and must never become instance profiles.

cleanup_fields.source_material_names: deduplicated source material asset names that FBX import may create in the mesh folder and that can be removed after material instances are assigned
cleanup_fields.source_texture_names: deduplicated source texture asset names that FBX import may create in the mesh folder and that can be removed after textures are imported to the canonical texture folder

transfer_request_fields.source: Blender transfer source object name from Vertex Data Tools
transfer_request_fields.shape_keys: boolean, request Shape Key transfer before mesh export
transfer_request_fields.weights: boolean, request robust weight transfer before mesh export
transfer_request_fields.enabled: boolean, true only when a source exists and at least one transfer operation is requested

validation_policy.textureless_materials: Allowed. They produce warnings in UE Unique but do not block JSON; Unreal can still create/assign an MI with empty texture parameters.
blocking_errors: unclean target/material names that would change on write
missing texture file paths or missing texture files when textures are present

production_group_suffix.rule: After normal material-name cleanup, the last independent numeric segment is the boundary. If a non-empty suffix follows it through a configured separator, the base is the full name through that numeric segment and the production group is the entire remaining suffix. Names without such a suffix keep the full name as their base and have no production group. No token allowlist is used.
production_group_suffix.compatibility_field: material_intent.production_group_tokens remains an array for existing consumers, but contract version 2 emits either [] or one complete normalized suffix such as ['winter_dry']; it no longer emits every recognized word found anywhere in the name.
production_group_suffix.safety_boundary: This parser derives grouping metadata only. It does not prove SPM/STMAT provenance, compare source signatures, or authorize atlas splitting or source mutation. Application runtimes must enforce pcg_atlas_auto_split.requires_provenance_and_matching_source_signature before acting on parsed groups.

pcg_atlas_auto_split.eligibility: any non-empty material_name.production_group_suffix; no label allowlist
pcg_atlas_auto_split.namespace_note: Atlas Builder production groups are independent from Tree instance_profile even when both values happen to be 'dead'. Automatic collection-classifier labels belong to Atlas Leaf Mesh Builder and do not restrict user collection names.

current_default.implemented_in: BlenderTools send2ue core/utilities.py sync_unreal_mesh_folder_path() (single hardcoded anchor)

unreal_path_mapping.risk: A single hardcoded anchor is fragile when a local subtree does not mirror the Unreal content path. This already broke the character/ subtree once.
unreal_path_mapping.target_direction: Support multiple mappings and/or a sidecar file next to the .blend, and fail loudly when no mapping matches instead of silently using a plausible-but-wrong path.

minimum_real_round_trip: Update Painter on an existing project
Confirm low reload without mesh-map bake for High-to-Low low-only edits
Confirm rebake for Low Poly as High low edits
Confirm _back Texture Sets use the matching front Normal mesh map while baking the remaining mesh maps
Send to Unreal handoff through the Export collection
